title: Survival RPG Pojav
body:
⚔️ Pocket RPG: Lightweight Adventure & Dungeon


Welcome to Pocket RPG, a lightweight Minecraft 1.20.1 modpack built on Fabric, specifically optimized for low-end computers and laptops. If you want to experience an epic RPG adventure, conquer challenging dungeons, but are held back by system limitations (**runs smoothly with only 1.5 GB / 1500 MB of allocated RAM at 4-6 render chunks**), then this is the perfect modpack for you!
This pack focuses on low-impact exploration, massive performance boosts, and classic RPG mechanics without ruining the original Minecraft aesthetic (Vanilla+ style)

✨ Key Features

🚀 **1. Super Lightweight Optimization (RAM Saver)**
This modpack uses a modern combination of performance mods to guarantee high FPS while keeping RAM usage well under 1.5GB 
- ModernFix & FerriteCore: Drastically cuts down Minecraft's memory footprint and regularly cleans up unused RAM.
- Sodium & Lithium: Optimizes graphics rendering (FPS) and internal server logic so mob movements and combat stay fluid
- EntityCulling: Prevents the game from rendering hidden mobs and treasure chests behind dungeon walls, significantly reducing CPU load.

  🗺️** 2. RPG Dungeons & Structure Exploration**
Even though it is highly optimized, your Minecraft world will feel much more alive and adventurous with structures that utilize vanilla blocks to keep memory usage minimal:
- YUNG's Better Dungeons & Mineshafts: A complete redesign of vanilla dungeons and abandoned mineshafts to make them feel grand and mysterious.
- Explorify & Moog's Voyager Structures: Adds ancient ruins, watchtowers, and campsites dynamically scattered across the world.
- Waystones: Discover or craft teleportation stones to quickly travel between your base, villages, or the entrance of the deepest dungeons.
  
  🎒 **3. RPG Mechanics & Quality of Life (QoL)**
- 1. Lootr: Personalized dungeon chests. Every player gets their own individual loot, meaning no more fighting over treasure when playing with friends!
- Trinkets: Extra accessory slots for rings, necklaces, or capes that you discover during your journey.
- Traveler's Backpack: A practical backpack featuring extra storage and a portable sleeping bag—extremely useful when lost deep inside a dungeon.
- Jade & Xaero's Minimap: Real-time health bar display above monsters and a lightweight minimap to help you navigate.

  🔧 **Recommended In-Game Settings**
For the absolute best performance on 1500 MB (1.5 GB) RAM, please apply these settings inside the game:
1. RAM Allocation (Launcher): Set to 1500 MB - 2048 MB (if possible).
2. Render Distance: 4 or 5 Chunks (Maximum 6 Chunks).
3. Simulation Distance: 5 Chunks.
4. Graphics: Fast.
5. Smooth Lighting: Off or Minimum.
6. Particles: Decreased or Minimal.
Happy adventuring, and may you conquer every dungeon in your path! 🛡️
